note: Silhouette score in [-1,1]; higher means tighter, better-separated clusters under that grouping. Computed in the 10-component PCA space (not the 2D plot alone) for a less cherry-picked estimate. A higher device-silhouette than class-silhouette would indicate the frozen HuBERT embedding space separates recording device more cleanly than it separates the apnea-event label -- i.e. device identity is an easier, more dominant signal in this representation than the clinical label itself.
